node.title: Environmental and Climate Workshop – Thursday, 24 September

bannerV2.name: glacier morteratsch glacier mountains summit alps mountain landscape bernina graubünden switzerland pxclimate protection pxclimateaction nature earth day

node.description:
Dear DP students and parents,

Next Thursday, 24 September, we will have a guest scientist at school, Dr. Giulio Settanta, who will lead a workshop on environmental and climate science for all our DP students. A description of the activity is provided below.

The activity is aimed at school students and provides an overview of some of the activities carried out by ISPRA (Italian Institute for Environmental Protection and Research). Topics include climate and climate variation, adaptation to climate change, urban green infrastructure, and sustainable mobility. The activity includes both a presentation and an interactive part, during which students will be guided through the analysis of climate data.

The schedule is as follows:

  • Thursday, 24 September, from 9:00 to 11:30: all DP1 students
  • Thursday, 24 September, from 12:00 to 13:00 and from 13:45 to 15:15: all DP2 students

Attendance at the workshop is mandatory for all DP students. Students will be excused from the classes that overlap with the activity.

We are looking forward to this experience!

Best regards,

Ms Meraviglia

node.title: DP1 trip to Heidelberg - Thursday

bannerV2.name: landscape nature flow city water heidelberg

node.description:
Dear DP1 students,

The first day is already over! I was very happy to see you all again and to meet our new members.

It was a very productive day, and since we are on track with everything we need to complete by the end of this week, I think we all deserve to go out for a short trip around Heidelberg on Thursday morning (September 17).

The trip will only take up part of the morning, from 7:55 until around 11:00.

The plan is as follows:

  • We meet at 7:55 in front of the school
  • We go together to Bismarckplatz by tram (please bring your Deutschland ticket or regular tram ticket)
  • We walk along the Neckarwiese towards the Old Bridge, and then walk back to Bismarckplatz via Hauptstrasse.
  • From Bismarckplatz, we take the tram back to school.

From 11:00 to 13:00, we will finalize our doors' decorations and practice our learner profile performances for Friday afternoon.

I hope you enjoy the next two days at school, and I will see you all on Thursday!

Best

Ms. Meraviglia

node.title: Welcome to the IB DP

bannerV2.name: ai generated back to school school board education sign drawing

node.description:
Dear new DP1 students,

welcome back to school and welcome to the beginning of your next journey: the IB Diploma Programme.

You should have all received the welcome information and package from your homeroom teacher Ms. Meraviglia in the last days. Please check that you can all log into Toddle before the welcome week. Previous MYP students can use their usual school email accounts to log in.
Our new DP1 students can log into the system with their private email accounts and we will change them to the school email accounts in the course of the next week. Go to https://www.toddleapp.com/, click on "Sign in", use the student account, and if you have a GMAIL account, simply click on GMAIL and use your regular GMAIL data. If you cannot log in, do not worry and simply reach out to me. I can send you a one-time password and we will switch your accounts to the school email accounts anyways next week. On Toddle, you can already find your homeroom class, the TOK class, the CAS class, and the Extended Essay class. All subjects and the timetable function will be added at the beginning of next week.

Please bring your current DP subject choice list with you in the welcome week. I have received mulitple emails with requests to change levels and subjects during the break and I tried my best to include them all into my subject choice document. However, I want to go through each subject choice with every student to check that we fulfil all requirements for IB (and also German universities) and to ensure that you will be enrolled into the correct classes. In addition, please bring a laptop or tablet (and a charger), so that you can participate properly.

I am looking forward to meeting you all in the course of next week. Please be in front of the school on Monday by 7:55. Ms. Meraviglia will meet you there and guide you to your classroom. I will check in in the course of the day and introduce you to some basics regarding the IB Diploma Programme and the different types of assessment in this year.

Have a great start everyone!

All the best,

Mr. Metzger (IB Diploma Programme Coordinator)

node.title: DP1: welcome to the new academic year!
node.description:
Dear students and parents,

The new academic year is approaching, and I would like to share (or re-share) with all of you, both old and new students, all the information you need to know to navigate the first weeks of school effectively.


In particular, you will find the following documents attached:

  • The booklist for the entire DP programme
  • A welcome letter from Mr. Metzger, Dr. Heinicke and me
  • A presentation containing relevant information about the IB DP programme, your DP subjects and teachers, and the timetable for the first week of school (14.09 - 18.09).
  • A document with information about the Meet and Greet evening (22.09) for parents.


I would also like to draw your attention to the fact that we will hold a kick-off party at school on Friday, September 18th, from 13:45 to 16:00. The event is compulsory for all students, and parents are warmly invited!


I am looking forward to this fresh new start, and I will see all of you next Monday.

Enjoy the rest of your week!


Kind regards

Anita Meraviglia
